prompts.title: K-pop 偶像比心拍照重现提示词
prompts.description: 这是一个结构化的 JSON 提示，通过 GeminiApp 为 Nano Banana Pro 创建，旨在重现两名 K-pop 偶像（LE SSERAFIM 的采源和咲良）指向左侧的图像。该提示详细描述了她们的外貌、姿势、搭配的黄色乳胶紧身衣、纯青色背景以及充满活力的摄影棚灯光，并指定了 3:4 的宽高比。

prompts.title: 脏粉色镜面闪光自拍
prompts.description: 一个高度详细、结构化的 JSON 提示词，用于 Nano Banana Pro 生成一张 K-pop 偶像 Rosé 的粗犷低保真镜面自拍。该提示词详细说明了她的姿势（跪姿）、服装（黑色湿感短款罩衫和破洞丝袜）、环境细节和灯光效果，强调了刺眼的相机闪光灯和去饱和的冷色调美学。
prompts.content: Grungy mirror selfie of Rosé (K-pop idol) kneeling on a wood floor. She wears a black wet-look cropped long-sleeve shrug over a black zippered bodysuit with blue trim, plus sheer black tights laddered on the right leg. Blonde hair, signature double eyelids, elegant features. A harsh camera flash creates a massive starburst flare. Background features white closet doors to the left, white paneled wall to the right. Dirty mirror surface. --ar 3:4. Physical: Pale skin, long platinum blonde hair, slim build, refined facial features characteristic of Rosé, soft eye makeup, no facial piercings. Pose: Kneeling, resting weight on left arm behind her, right arm raised holding the camera. Top: Black shiny latex/PVC long-sleeve shrug. Black bodysuit underneath, deep neckline, front zipper, thin slate-blue trim along zipper and seams. Bottoms: Sheer black tights, severe runs/rips on the right thigh. A dark text tattoo is visible beneath the ripped tights. Accessories: White cord dangling from camera. Floor: Light brown wood plank flooring. Left background: White paneled wardrobe doors with horizontal metal handles, slightly ajar. Right background: White wainscoting/paneled wall, edge of a bed. Foreground: Smudged and scratched mirror glass. Lighting: Direct flash photography. Artifacts: Intense white flash glare obscuring the device and hand, light streaking, hazy soft-focus look, visible mirror dust. Color grading: Desaturated, cool-toned, low-fi dark aesthetic with blown-out highlights. Exact colors: Flash glare #FFFFFF, deep shadows #08090A, latex highlight #4B4E54, skin base #F2E1D9, blush tone #D4A5A5, zipper trim #4A6178, wood floor #574336, shadowed cabinets #7B7E83.
prompts.translatedContent: Rosé（韩国流行偶像）跪坐在木地板上，拍摄了一张脏兮兮的镜子自拍照。她身穿黑色湿面短款长袖罩衫，内搭黑色拉链紧身衣，紧身衣带有蓝色饰边。她还穿着黑色透明丝袜，右腿丝袜有脱线。金发，标志性的双眼皮，五官精致。刺眼的相机闪光灯产生了巨大的星芒眩光。背景左侧是白色衣柜门，右侧是白色镶板墙。镜子表面很脏。--ar 3:4。身体特征：皮肤白皙，铂金色长发，身材苗条，具有 Rosé 标志性的精致五官，柔和的眼妆，无面部穿孔。姿势：跪姿，身体重心放在身后的左臂上，右臂抬起握着相机。上衣：黑色闪亮乳胶/PVC 长袖罩衫。内搭黑色紧身衣，深领口，正面拉链，拉链和接缝处有细长的石板蓝色饰边。下装：黑色透明丝袜，右大腿处有严重的脱线/破洞。破洞丝袜下方可见一个深色文字纹身。配饰：相机上垂下一根白色绳索。地板：浅棕色木板地板。左侧背景：白色镶板衣柜门，带有水平金属把手，微开。右侧背景：白色护墙板/镶板墙，床的边缘。前景：沾满污迹和划痕的镜子玻璃。灯光：直射闪光灯摄影。瑕疵：强烈的白色闪光眩光遮挡了设备和手，光线拖影，朦胧的柔焦效果，可见镜子上的灰尘。色彩分级：去饱和，冷色调，低保真暗色美学，高光过曝。精确颜色：闪光眩光 #FFFFFF，深阴影 #08090A，乳胶高光 #4B4E54，皮肤基色 #F2E1D9，腮红色调 #D4A5A5，拉链饰边 #4A6178，木地板 #574336，阴影柜子 #7B7E83。

prompts.title: 3D 卡通漫画肖像
prompts.description: 一个用于生成高度细致、半写实 3D 卡通漫画肖像的提示，描绘了一位兴奋的胡须男士，他身穿栗色 Nike 连帽衫，戴着黑色椭圆形太阳镜，重点突出粗犷的轮廓、富有光泽的眼睛和细致的头发纹理。
prompts.content: A highly detailed cartoon caricature portrait of an excited bearded man with thick brown hair and large black oval sunglasses, with natural smile, brown eyes, and a joyful expression. He has a trimmed brown beard and mustacheb and wears a {argument name="clothing item" default="nike maroon nike hoodie"} over a white shirt. Around his neck is a silver dog tag necklace engraved with the initials "{argument name="initials" default="X"}". The style is vibrant, semi-realistic caricature illustration with bold outlines, glossy eyes, detailed hair and beard texture, and dramatic facial exaggeration. Clean light gray background, centered portrait, studio lighting, ultra sharp, digital illustration, 4k, professional cartoon character design.

prompts.title: 超逼真芬达产品拍摄提示词
prompts.description: 为 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 设计的提示，用于创建一张超逼真的生活方式产品照片：一罐冰镇的 Buko Pandan 风味 FANTA 饮料，置于热带海滩上的一张风化木桌上。场景中包含冷凝水珠、黄金时段的阳光、切半的椰子、香兰叶、绿色果冻块和融化的冰块，强调商业饮料风格、浅景深和充满活力的热带色调，分辨率为 8K。
prompts.content: Hyper-realistic lifestyle product shot of a cold FANTA – {argument name="flavor" default="Buko Pandan"} can placed upright on a weathered wooden table on a tropical beach. The can is glistening with condensation under warm golden-hour sunlight. Surrounding elements include halved coconuts, pandan leaves, green jelly cubes, and melting ice scattered naturally. In the background, soft-focus palm trees and ocean waves create a dreamy bokeh effect. Composition is balanced and inviting, with warm highlights and soft shadows. Shot in commercial beverage style, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing, vibrant tropical tones, ultra-detailed textures, 8K resolution.
prompts.translatedContent: 热带海滩上，一张饱经风霜的木桌上立着一罐冰镇芬达——{argument name="flavor" default="Buko Pandan"} 味，超逼真的生活方式产品特写。罐身在温暖的黄金时段阳光下闪耀着冷凝水。周围散落着切半的椰子、斑斓叶、绿色果冻块和融化的冰块。背景中，柔焦的棕榈树和海浪营造出梦幻般的散景效果。构图均衡且诱人，带有温暖的高光和柔和的阴影。以商业饮料风格拍摄，浅景深，电影级构图，鲜艳的热带色调，超精细纹理，8K 分辨率。
